mapper.insert: insert into agent_run ( run_id, session_id, turn_id, status, current_step, step_count, tool_call_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, fallback_reason, error_code, started_at, finished_at ) select #{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{stepCount}, #{toolCallCount}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{fallbackReason}, #{errorCode}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt} from dual where exists ( select 1 from conversation_session where session_id=#{sessionId} and deleted_at is null ) on duplicate key update turn_id = values(turn_id), status = values(status), current_step = values(current_step), step_count = values(step_count), tool_call_count = values(tool_call_count), prompt_tokens = values(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = values(completion_tokens), latency_ms = values(latency_ms), fallback_reason = values(fallback_reason), error_code = values(error_code), finished_at = values(finished_at)

insert into agent_step ( step_id, run_id, step_order, step_type, attempt, status, decision_code, input_summary, output_summary, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, error_code, created_at ) values ( #{stepId}, #{runId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{attempt}, #{status}, #{decisionCode}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt} ) on duplicate key update created_at = if(values(attempt) > attempt, values(created_at), created_at), attempt = values(attempt), status = values(status), decision_code = values(decision_code), input_summary = values(input_summary), output_summary = values(output_summary), prompt_tokens = values(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = values(completion_tokens), latency_ms = values(latency_ms), error_code = values(error_code)
mapper.select: select r.* from agent_run r join conversation_session s on s.session_id = r.session_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.deleted_at is null and ( r.status in ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_TASK', 'AWAITING_TURN') or r.started_at >= date_sub(current_timestamp(3), interval 10 minute) ) order by case when r.status in ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_TASK', 'AWAITING_TURN') then 0 else 1 end, r.started_at desc, r.run_id desc limit #{limit}
select * from agent_step where run_id = #{runId} order by step_order asc
